name: China Sports Industry Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1998 and headquartered in Beijing, China Sports Industry Group Co., Ltd. is a diversified enterprise with core activities spanning the real estate and sports industries. Within the real estate sector, the company undertakes development and management projects. Its extensive involvement in sports includes brand management, information services, event hosting, specialized IT consulting, event planning, and advisory services. Furthermore, the group offers sports brokerage, project management, and training programs, alongside providing fitness services and retailing sports equipment. They are also actively engaged in the comprehensive management and operation of events and sports venues, including participation in sports lottery initiatives. Beyond its primary focus, the company's portfolio extends to air passenger and freight forwarding, the production and sale of Fiber Reinforced Polymer (FRP) products, and a range of technical services such as certification, testing, development, consulting, training, and data processing. Additional ventures include printed matter production, computer software and hardware sales, architectural engineering design, and various investment activities encompassing equity, project, and fund management, as well as general engineering design and construction services.
